cases.sentence: Когда Раваам прибыл в ___, он собрал сто восемьдесят тысяч отборных воинов.
cases.translation: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he gathered one hundred and eighty thousand chosen warriors.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (to) with motion toward a place governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он собрал сто восемьдесят тысяч отборных воинов из дома Иуды и ___.
cases.translation: He gathered one hundred and eighty thousand chosen warriors from the house of Judah and Benjamin.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Но Шимаи, Божьему ___, было от Бога такое слово.
cases.translation: But to Shemaiah, the man of God, came such a word from God.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative in apposition uses the dative case after the adjective.

cases.translation: 'Do not go to war with your brothers.'
cases.explain: The preposition 'со' (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Раваам укрепил в Иудее города для ___.
cases.translation: Rehoboam fortified cities in Judah for defense.
cases.explain: The preposition 'для' (for/in order to) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он устроил во всех этих городах хранилища для хлеба, оливкового масла и ___.
cases.translation: He arranged storehouses in all these cities for grain, olive oil, and wine.
cases.explain: In a list with 'для' (for), the genitive case is used throughout.

cases.sentence: Священники и левиты из всех областей земли ___.
cases.translation: The priests and Levites from all regions of the land of Israel.
cases.explain: The genitive 'земли Израиля' (land of Israel) shows possession and relationship.
After the verb 'женился на' (married), the prepositional case is used with 'на'.

reading.ru: Когда Раваам прибыл в Иерусалим, он собрал сто восемьдесят тысяч отборных воинов из дома Иуды и Вениамина, чтобы воевать с Израилем и вернуть себе царство.
reading.question: What did King Rehoboam do when he returned to Jerusalem?
options: He gathered 180,000 soldiers to fight Israel and reclaim his kingdom
reading.correct: He gathered 180,000 soldiers to fight Israel and reclaim his kingdom
reading.explain: The text says he 'собрал сто восемьдесят тысяч отборных воинов ... чтобы воевать' — gathered 180,000 soldiers to fight.

reading.ru: Но Шимаи, Божьему человеку, было от Бога такое слово.
reading.question: To whom did God's word come?
options: To Shemaiah, the man of God
reading.correct: To Shemaiah, the man of God
reading.explain: The text says 'Шимаи, Божьему человеку, было от Бога такое слово' — to Shemaiah, the man of God, came such a word.

reading.ru: «Не ходите воевать со своими братьями, ступайте все по домам, потому что это произошло по моей воле».
reading.question: What was God's message through the prophet?
options: Do not go to war with your brothers; go home because this has happened by God's will
Go to war and destroy Israel
reading.correct: Do not go to war with your brothers; go home because this has happened by God's will
reading.explain: The word from God says 'не ходите воевать со своими братьями' — do not go to war with your brothers.

reading.ru: Раваам жил в Иерусалиме и укрепил в Иудее города для защиты.
reading.question: What did King Rehoboam do in his cities?
reading.explain: The text says 'укрепил в Иудее города для защиты' — he fortified cities in Judah for defense.

reading.ru: Священники и левиты из всех областей земли Израиля встали на его сторону.
reading.question: Did the priests and Levites support King Rehoboam?
reading.explain: The text says 'встали на его сторону' — stood on his side, meaning they supported him.

reading.ru: Левиты даже оставили свои пастбища и все добро и отправились в Иудею и Иерусалим.
reading.question: How did the Levites show their loyalty to King Rehoboam?
options: They abandoned their possessions and moved to Judah and Jerusalem
They gave him money and gifts
They built him a new palace
reading.correct: They abandoned their possessions and moved to Judah and Jerusalem
reading.explain: The text says 'оставили свои пастбища и все добро и отправились в Иудею' — abandoned their possessions and went to Judah.
